identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study of SHR-1826 for Injection in Patients With NSCLC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II, Multicenter, Open-Label Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability and Efficacy of SHR-1826 for Injection in Patients With NSCLC

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is an open-label, multicenter Phase II clinical trial to evaluate the safety, tolerability and efficacy of SHR-1826 for injection in patients with NSCLC.

armGroups.label: Arm A
armGroups.description: SHR-1826 for injection in combination with Adebrelimab injection and SHR-8068 with or without Bevacizumab injection

interventions.name: SHR-1826；Adebrelimab；SHR-8068；Bevacizumab
interventions.description:
Drug:

Drug: SHR-1826 Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

Drug: Adebrelimab Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

Drug: SHR-8068 Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 6 weeks.

Drug: Bevacizumab Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of adverse events (AEs) /serious adverse events(SAEs)

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: approximately to 5 years after last subject enrolled

locations.facility: Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) General Hospital
